job.title: Intern – Python Development & Data Analysis
job.description:
Company Description
At PQ Technologies AG (PQT), we build data processing solutions for the financial industry, working with both structured and unstructured data. Our focus is the End-to-End Compliance & Risk process at banks and financial institutions, in particular Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money-Laundering (AML).
We are a multidisciplinary team of 10–15 people in Zurich, combining deep domain expertise in Compliance & Risk with strong engineering capabilities. Our software runs inside our clients' critical processes at leading financial institutions, tested and relied on daily.
Role Description
We are looking for an intern for a paid, 6-month fixed-term internship, supporting the development of data processing and evaluation systems on top of our Nucleus Compliance & Risk Engine, for leading financial institutions. You'll work closely with our engineers and our Compliance & Risk specialists, and contribute to projects that go live with our clients.
Key responsibilities
Develop (Python) code for data processing and evaluation on our Nucleus Compliance & Risk Engine
Perform data analysis on real datasets in the KYC/AML domain
Support the delivery teams with analysis, testing, documentation and preparation of client sessions
What you will gain
Experience in delivering production-ready code
Practical experience with LLM supported applications in production
Insight into B2B customer communication with regulated financial institutions, and into how client projects are delivered
Direct mentoring from senior engineers and real ownership of your work
Location & commitment
Hybrid — Zurich office, with remote days
Fixed-term internship, 6 months, 70–100%
Start date: 1 September 2026
CHF 4,200 gross per month (paid internship)
No relocation support and no visa sponsorship; travel is limited to occasional client meetings
Extension or permanent role possible after the internship
Qualifications
Currently enrolled in a BSc or MSc in a STEM field at a Swiss university, or a recent graduate
Programming knowledge and experience in Python
A good understanding of algorithms and data structures
Ability to work in a dynamic environment with different types of duties
Valid permission to work in Switzerland
The drive to work independently and pick up new things across different areas
Nice to have — experience working on code collaboratively
No prior compliance or finance knowledge is expected. We care more about attitude and curiosity than a long list of prior experience — we're there to support you, and we're looking for self-starters.

job.title: Product Engineer
job.description:
The Context Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.
 Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.
 We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.
 
 The Mission You'll own features in their entirety. Self-standing or with guidance of founders and fellow engineers, you turn a clear problem statement into a strong design and build, test, and ship new features that directly enable our customers. You integrate features across our layered stack, from the API to the data plane, and carry them all the way to production.
 This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.
 
 Your responsibilities Ship features end-to-end: Deliver complete vertical slices across the stack, from the API layer to the data model, carried through to running in production.

 Grow what the platform does for banks: Build the services Porters performs for banks: Extend the capabilities of our agentic platform such as case handling, customer matching, AI tool integrations, data enrichment, or keeping humans in the loop.

 Deliver features that hold together as a system: Design endpoints, contracts, and interfaces that work together, ensuring features integrate cleanly towards one bigger outcome.

 Ensure your work is reliable: Own design, development, tests, and deployment, so what reaches production is proven to work.

 Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”.

 
 Your profile Experience: Around 4 years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

 Product thinking: You naturally understand why you’re building something, not just focusing on how to build.

 Quality focus & individual problem solving: Given a clear problem, you reliably produce a clean algorithm, a sensible data model, a well-struct
[... middle of the posting omitted ...]
development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

 Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.
 
 Our stack Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

 Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

 AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

 Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

 Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

 Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

 Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.
